title: P@x model list
description: The providers P@x can use, each by an identifier with an adapter family (ADR-0004, amended 12 November 2026), the models offered for each, and their prices. Read from /etc/tur/pax/models.json if it exists, else /usr/share/tur/pax/models.json; never written by P@x. Model names and prices are configuration, never compiled in (ADR-0004). A model the person types that is not listed is accepted; its price is then not known and P@x limits it in tokens. The loader in services/tur-pax (settings.rs) is authoritative and also enforces: a provider is listed once; a model name is listed once per provider, with no control characters and no surrounding whitespace; prices follow the rules of the provider configuration (finite, not negative, a currency of 1 to 8 letters); an openai-chat entry names its base_url; key_required false and send_back_reasoning true are for openai-chat only; data_terms with runs_locally need a base_url on this computer, and reviewed data terms name the pages they were read from; runtime_key_file has no part that is . or .., and needs key_required and a base_url on this computer. The adapter families' own companies (anthropic, openai, google) exist without an entry, at their public addresses and with no prices. Generation settings: settings declares what the models of a provider, or one model, accept (temperature, top_p, top_k, stop, effort, thinking_budget, max_output_tokens, context_tokens), each with its range and the default P@x sends when the person chose none; a model's declaration overlays its provider's, setting by setting. A setting that is not declared is not offered and a choice of it is refused; a model with no declaration at all takes only an output limit. The loader also refuses a declaration whose ranges are out of order, whose defaults are outside them, or that names a setting the adapter family cannot be sent (services/tur-pax-providers, generation.rs); reasoning_style is for openai-chat only.

status.description: example: figures read on one day to show the format, not kept up to date. maintained: a list its publisher keeps up to date.

prices_as_of.description: The day the prices were read.

statement.description: One statement of TUR's summary of a provider's terms, in plain words.

capabilities.description: What is declared. Tool calling decides whether P@x offers tools; image input whether it offers screen control. Recorded as declared; the tool probe of tur-pax-providers can check tool calling.

id.description: The provider's identifier, by which settings, the interface and the keyring name it.

adapter.description: The adapter family that speaks its interface. The loader accepts the families the provider layer has: anthropic (Messages), openai (Responses), google (Interactions), openai-chat (the OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions of DeepSeek, other services and local servers).

key_required.description: Whether the service needs a key. false only for openai-chat, for a server that takes none (a model server on this computer).

runtime_key_file.description: Where the key is read in place of the password store: a file of the session's runtime directory ($XDG_RUNTIME_DIR), named relative to it, that a model server on this computer writes for the person each time it starts (tur-ai-local writes tur-ai-local/api-key, mode 0600). The file must be a regular file readable by its owner alone. Only for an entry that needs a key and whose base_url is this computer; the key is never sent to another address and never stored.

send_back_reasoning.description: openai-chat only: send the model's reasoning back with later requests, for a service whose documentation requires it (DeepSeek).

reasoning_style.description: openai-chat only: how the service is told how much its model reasons. reasoning_effort (the default): the reasoning_effort field. enable_thinking: llama.cpp's server, the chat template's switch chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking.

settings.description: The generation settings its models accept, unless a model declares otherwise.

data_terms.description: What the provider says about the data sent to it, as TUR read it. Without reviewed_on the terms are not reviewed by TUR, and the consent text says so; an entry the person adds by hand is never shown as reviewed.

reviewed_on.description: The day TUR read the pages in sources.

runs_locally.description: The model runs on this computer; the base_url must be a loopback address.

data_terms_url.description: Where the provider says how it handles data sent to its interface. Shown with the consent text.

key_url.description: Where a person gets a key.

capabilities.description: What this model declares, in place of what its provider declares.

max_output_tokens.description: P@x's own limit for one response with this model.

tested_with_tur.description: Whether the project ran its conformance tests against this model.

prices.description: Per million tokens. Absent when the price is not known or cannot be stated in this form.

settings.description: The generation settings this model accepts, in place of what its provider declares.

base_url.description: Its address, if it is not the public address of its adapter family: https, or http for a loopback host only.

keyring_item.description: The name of the password store item that holds its key; its identifier when absent. 1 to 64 lower-case letters, digits, '.', '-' and '_', starting with a letter or a digit, with no two dots in a row (the loader checks that). Every provider identifier is one.

capabilities.description: What its models declare they can do, unless a model declares otherwise. A model that declares no tool calling is offered no tools.

effort.description: How much the model reasons: the union of the providers' levels.

default.description: What P@x sends when the person chose none. Absent: nothing is sent and the provider's own default applies.
What P@x uses when the person chose none.

settings.description: The generation settings a model accepts (services/tur-pax, tuning.rs). Each setting that is present is offered, in its range; one that is absent is not. Read from the provider's documentation on the date in checked, from the pages in sources.

effort.description: The reasoning efforts the model takes.

default.description: What P@x sends when the person chose none.

provider_default.description: What the provider applies when nothing is sent, as its documentation says; used for the rule of sampling_only_with.

sampling_only_with.description: Temperature, top_p and top_k are taken only at these efforts: the model refuses or ignores them while it reasons.

context_tokens.description: A model on this computer: the context tur-ai-local starts it with.
